tagline: Practise money decisions safely — make choices, see consequences, try again.
welcome_body: Short stories where you make money choices with pretend money and see what happens.
pretend_money_short: Pretend money only — no real payments.
notice_point_fictional: All money, accounts and coins in Gullak are fictional. They have no real value.
notice_point_no_payments: No real payments, transfers or bank links. Nothing can be bought or cashed out.
notice_point_simulation: Investing missions use invented assets and made-up outcomes. They are not financial advice.
notice_point_privacy: We never ask for your real name, phone, school, location or family money details.
notice_point_offline: Gullak works offline. Your progress stays on this phone unless you link it to your NGO, which is optional.
profile_body: Add a nickname so several students can share this phone. Everything here is optional.
profile_existing: Already have a profile on this phone?
profile_nickname_help: Not your real name. Up to 20 letters.
profile_privacy: Saved only on this phone. No email, phone number or login needed.
profile_name_taken: That nickname is already used on this phone. Try another one.
profile_local_only: Local profile — stays on this phone
level_body: Start at the level that suits you. More levels are on the way.
level_easy_desc: One decision, one clear goal, with hints.
level_advanced_desc: Several goals and comparing outcomes over time.
more_levels_later: Medium and Advanced are coming later.
stay_safe_teaser: Never share a PIN or OTP. Tap for safety tips.
mission_unavailable: This mission is not available right now.
study_any_order: Study first or play first — your choice.
study_unavailable: Study material for this topic is not available right now.
question: Question
quiz_not_quite: Not quite. Each option explains why.
quiz_keep_going: Good effort. You can retry any time — your best score is kept.
resume_note: You left this mission part-way. Resume, or start over.
growth_info: Made-up rule: the jar grows {rate}% each year.
error_save: Could not save. Please try again.
error_invalid_choice: That choice can't be used here. Please pick again.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Your saved progress is safe.
no_penalty: No penalty for trying. Wrong choices are part of learning.
badges_private: Only you can see these. There are no rankings.
stay_safe_intro: These tips protect real money too. Read them any time.
language_keeps_progress: Switching language keeps all your progress.
reset_progress_body: This clears the story, stars and badges for this profile only. Other profiles are not affected.
clear_all: Delete all data on this phone
clear_all_body: This deletes every profile and all progress on this phone. It cannot be undone.
about_body: Gullak teaches money skills with pretend money. It has no real payments, needs no login and works offline. If you link an NGO, your progress summary is shared with it when online. It does not give financial advice.
read_aloud_on_note: Story text is spoken when it appears. Tap the speaker on any text to hear it again.
read_aloud_off_note: Turn on to hear the story and choices read out.
read_aloud_sample: This is how I will read the story to you.
read_aloud_no_voice: This phone has no offline voice for this language yet. Download one in Android Settings → Text-to-speech output → Install voice data.
daily_week: Check in 7 days in a row for a ₹{bonus} bonus.
inbox_empty: Nothing yet. Check in or finish a chapter and your news will show up here.
inbox_checkIn: Daily check-in: ₹{reward} added to your Gullak. Streak day {streak}.
inbox_streak: 🔥 {streak}-day streak! Keep coming back every day.
inbox_storyDone: 🏆 You finished all of The Money Diaries! Replay any chapter to practise.
reminders_on_note: A notification each day for your check-in and the next chapter.
reminders_off_note: Turn on to get a nudge each day so you keep your streak.
reminders_denied: Notifications are blocked for Gullak. Allow them in Android Settings → Apps → Gullak → Notifications.
rem_body: Check in today and drop ₹{reward} into your Gullak.
rem_body_streak: Check in today for ₹{reward} so your streak keeps going.
rem_body_miss: We miss you! Check in to collect ₹{reward}.
ngo_body: If an NGO or learning centre gave you a code, enter it here. Your teacher can then see how far you have got in the story.
ngo_offline_check: No internet right now. You can save the code and Gullak will join when you are online.
ngo_code_not_found: We could not find this code. Check it with your teacher.
ngo_code_revoked: This code is no longer active. Ask your NGO for a new one.
ngo_server_busy: The NGO server is busy. Your code is saved; Gullak will try again later.
ngo_shared_title: What is shared with your NGO
ngo_share_yes: Chapters finished, stars, badges, and the choices you made at key moments of the story (for example, whether you checked a suspicious message).
ngo_share_no: Never your nickname, real name, phone number, location or the pretend money amounts.
ngo_share_when: Progress is sent only when the phone is online. Gullak still works fully offline.
ngo_share_stop: You can unlink at any time in Settings. The NGO's copy is then deleted; your game on this phone stays.
ngo_consent: I agree to share my game progress with this NGO. (If you are under 18, check with your parent or teacher first.)
ngo_skip_note: You can join an NGO later in Settings.
ngo_joined: Linked to {ngo}! Your progress will be shared when you are online.
ngo_saved_offline: Code saved. Gullak will join {code} when you are online.
ngo_not_linked: Not linked to an NGO. Your progress stays only on this phone.
ngo_rejected: The code {code} was not accepted. Enter a new code.
ngo_revoked: Your NGO link was turned off. Enter a new code to link again.
ngo_unlink_body: Gullak will stop sharing your progress and ask the NGO to delete its copy. Your game and progress on this phone stay as they are.
ngo_unlinked: Unlinked. Your game progress is still here.
ngo_unlinking: Unlinking… the NGO will be told when you are online.
